_note: Describes only what this package actually ships: the UI frames the engine chrome draws with. The purchased character/monster/terrain art is licensed for use but not for redistribution, so it is absent here and the lists below are empty on purpose -- PixelPack.has() then returns false and the engine draws its own art instead. Drop the full pack and its own catalog.json into ./assets/pixelpack/ to re-activate it locally; the /assets mount prefers that directory per file.
